email_subject: Application - Junior Digital Project Coordinator – Web & Communications
email_body:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm applying for the Junior Digital Project Coordinator – Web & Communications role at Euroports. Your focus on launching a new corporate website and strengthening digital communications across the Group matches exactly where I want to build my career.

In my current freelance and junior digital marketing work, I design, build and manage WordPress sites with Elementor, handle content migration and multilingual updates, and use SEO and analytics tools to track performance. I've also coordinated website projects from structure to launch, working with internal teams and external partners. I'm comfortable with Canva, Google Analytics, Search Console and LinkedIn, and I use AI tools daily to improve content and efficiency.

I'm organised, proactive and enjoy taking ownership of projects. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to Euroports' digital presence and grow with your Group Marketing & Communications team.

Thank you for considering my application.

Kind regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Hiring Team,

I'm writing to apply for the Junior Digital Project Coordinator – Web & Communications position at Euroports. The opportunity to coordinate the launch of a new corporate website and then help shape digital content and external communications across the Group is exactly the kind of hands-on, international project I'm looking for at this stage of my career.

My background sits where web, content and SEO meet. In my current freelance work and as a junior digital marketer at Episto, I build and manage WordPress sites using Elementor, Astra and Rank Math, publish and update pages and blog posts, and keep existing content current. I've built a multi-page website for a Belgian youth chess champion from scratch, including structured data and technical SEO audits, and I'm currently building and maintaining a pharmacists' association site with a consistent layout for around 600 member profile pages. This has given me practical experience in content migration, site structure and the kind of detail work that a website redesign demands.

I'm organised and proactive, and I enjoy taking ownership of projects from planning through to launch. I use Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush and Ahrefs to monitor performance, and I work with Canva and LinkedIn for digital content. I'm also curious about AI and use LLMs daily to improve content creation and efficiency, which I'd be keen to bring to your team.

I'm fluent in English and comfortable working with different teams and stakeholders. I'd welcome the chance to contribute to Euroports' digital visibility and to grow within your Group Marketing & Communications team.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to hearing from you.

Kind regards,
Baver Ok

cv_highlights:

• CMS content management: publishing and updating pages, blog posts and media for client websites in WordPress (Elementor, Astra, Rank Math), including a ~600-page member profile layout.
• Digital tools and analytics: Google Analytics, Search Console, Semrush, Ahrefs, Canva, LinkedIn; daily use of AI tools (LLMs) for content and efficiency.
